work_history.title: Technical Sales Specialist
work_history.description: Drive business development and promote flavor and ingredient portfolios across Central Java and Eastern Indonesia. Identify new business opportunities and establish long-term customer relationships. Provide technical consultation and recommend suitable ingredient and flavor solutions. Develop customized flavor prototypes for tobacco and vape applications. Source and collaborate with global suppliers to strengthen product portfolios. Expand the ingredient portfolio across food, beverage, cosmetics, confectionery, tobacco, and vape industries. Conduct product presentations, technical discussions, application trials, and customer visits.

work_history.title: International Sales Executive
work_history.description: Developed international business opportunities and new projects. Expanded natural products into international markets. Coordinated cross-functional departments from purchase order processing to product delivery. Prepared sales performance and market development reports. Conducted email marketing campaigns for products and new business projects.

work_history.title: Marketing Executive
work_history.description: Marketed flavor products to existing and prospective customers. Expanded product distribution and market coverage. Coordinated order processing with the administration team. Prepared sales achievement and deployment reports. Assisted customers in developing customized flavor solutions.

work_history.title: Intern
work_history.description: Supervised production processes from raw materials to finished goods. Monitored storage, production, quality, management, and marketing activities. Prepared operational reports for production activities.
